about_the_game:
This demo lets you discover the essence of BloomKeeper.
You play as the Guardian, a protective spirit of nature tasked with bringing life back to the hostile world around you. To succeed, you must help the Pouics, adorable little creatures naïve yet capable of reviving their environment.

THE POUICS!

In this one-hour demo, you will discover the core mechanics that let you create and interact with the Pouics. Through the complete tutorial and 3 levels across 2 biomes, you will also face BloomKeeper’s main challenge.

SOLO OR CO-OP

Once the tutorial is complete, you can continue alone or invite friends to join your adventure in cooperative multiplayer for up to 4 players.
Solo mode offers a gentle and peaceful experience, while multiplayer becomes more chaotic and demanding—especially with the arrival of the Malépouics...

WHAT’S MORE IN THE FULL GAME?

The final release will include 30 additional levels across 5 biomes, new mechanics, unique variations of Pouics, and a few more surprises.

short_description: Spread nature and breathe life back into a world of ash by guiding the Pouics, naive and curious little creatures. They dream of reawakening the world, but they can’t do it alone. Guide them, calm them, protect them and help them restore life to a forgotten land.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese
